title: 낙동강수계관리위원회규정 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Advisory Committee)
(1) The advisory committee under Article 37 (5) of the Act shall consist of not more than 28 members, including one chairperson, taking gender into consideration. <Amended on January 31, 2017>
(2) Members of the advisory committee shall be as follows: <Amended on January 31, 2017; June 4, 2024>
1. One resident representative, one civil society organization representative, one industry representative, and one environmental expert from each relevant metropolitan city or province, recommended by the Mayors of Busan, Daegu, and Ulsan Metropolitan Cities and the Governors of Gyeongsangbuk-do, Gyeongsangnam-do, and Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province;
2. At least one person appointed by the chairperson of the Committee from among persons with specialized knowledge and experience in basin management, water quality conservation, environmental administration, etc.
(3) The chairperson of the advisory committee shall be elected from among its members and shall serve a two-year term.
(4) Members shall serve two-year terms and may be reappointed only twice. <Amended on January 31, 2017>
(5) Subcommittees by field may be established and operated to efficiently review advisory matters. <Newly Inserted on January 31, 2017>
